verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v1: hal rawḍaḍu ghannāʾu shimtu ʿiyānī fīhā gharāʾibu lam tara l-ʿaynāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v2: fīhā l-fawākihu waz-zuhūru wakullu mā qad tashtahīhi n-nafsu bil-ʾafnāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v3: ʾazhāruhā mithlu l-kawākibi fī s-samā fī ʾalyali watanawwaʿat lir-rānī
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v4: watarā ʿalā kabidi r-rubā ʾakmāmahā mithla l-jumāni taʿʿalaqat bilubāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v5: watasājalat fīhā ḥamāʾimu ghurradu wataghghanati l-ʾaṭyāru kulla zamāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v6: tuhdī ṣ-ṣabā ʾarajju r-rubā fīhā lanā mustanshiqīna rawāʾiḥa r-riḍwāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v7: ʾam qd badā ṣadafu tuʿawiruhu l-warā lammā ʾatā tazrī ʿuqūda jumāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v8: ʾam khāliṣu dh-dhahabi lladhī yunsīka min yāqūtati l-ḥamrāʾi wal-marjāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v9: bal ʾinnahu taʾalīfu ʿaylami ʾabḥuri wayaḥūzu qaṣba s-sabqi fī l-mīdāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v11: bal ʾinnahu taʾalīfu madḥi zamāninā fī quṭrinā n-nāʾī mina s-sūdānī
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v12: bal ʾinnahu taʾalīfu manbaʿi ḥikmahi muliʾa l-ḥadīthi wamuḥkama l-qurīʾāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v13: walaqad ʾatānā mā yunīru ghayāhibā fī mushkilati masāʾili l-ʿirfāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v14: sammāhu min khayri s-sumā bikifāyati lir-rāghbīna liḥaḍrati r-raḥmāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v15: ʾaw kāna ʾiqmāʿa limuḥdathi qawlihi fī millahi hiyā ʾashrafu l-ʾadyāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v16: hadhā kitābu yukhjilu d-durra n-nafī sa binashrihi wabadīʿihi wabayāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v17: hadhā kitābu qad takāmala fakhruhu mimman ʾatāhu shahīru fayḍi maʿāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v18: hadhā kitābu mufḥimu min mufhimi huwa yuʿjibu l-ʿulamāʾa fī l-buldāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v19: hadhā kitābu qad kafā min muktafi ʾaw muntafi mutanāhiḍi r-rukbāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v20: hadhā kitābu yunqidhu l-juhāla min nahji ḍ-ḍalalati lil-hudā waʾamāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v21: hadhā kitābu fīhi jamʿu manāfiʿi mimmā yushaddu bihi r-riḥālu lifāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v22: fakaʾannahu ʾaryu lidhāʾiqi mā bihi wirdu yunaqqaʿu ghullaha ẓ-ẓamʾāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v23: wadhawū l-baṣāʾiri yaʿrifūna biʾannahu bayḍu l-ʾanūqi fakayfa bil-wujdāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v24: hākum bituḥfahi māliki min māliki huwa mālikiyyu madhhabā ʾikhwānī
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v25: ʾaghlā shudhūra bil-ʾikhāʾi muʾallifu fī fiqhi madhhabi māliki dhī sh-shaʾani
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v26: qad rāqa maʿnā ḥusnuhu mutazāyidu kal-ʿabqariyyī fī s-sirri wal-ʾiʿlani
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v27: hadhā r-riḍī hadhā r-riḍī hadhā r-riḍī mawlayā zidhu min ʾabḥuri r-riḍwāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v28: man yuʾuta ḥikmaha rabbinā yalqa l-munā wayaḥūzu ḥaqqā minḥaha r-raḥmani
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v29: man kāna yarmī fī faḍāʾi faḍāʾili biqiyāsihi yahiman bighayri tawāni yā saʿda man jaʿala l-kitāba rafīqahu
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v31: ʾaqlami bayna ʾanāmili wabanāni yazdādu min himami ʿalat min baʿdimā himami wayatruku mā ḥawathu yadāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v32: ḥattā yushāhida mā bihi mina minḥahi wakifāyati waʿināyati l-mannāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v33: yā qudwata ṭalaʿat lahu shamsu l-maʿā rifi fī samāʾi l-fatḥi ʿan kitmāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v34: lil-hi darruka ṣāḥiba t-taʾalīfi mā nasajat ʿalayka ʿanākibu n-nisyāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v35: lam yabqa fīhi ziyādatu lʾikābiri wabidāyatu l-fityāni wash-shubbāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v37: waqadi rtadayta binasjihā ḥulala r-riḍā dhayyaltahā kamaṭāriqi wayamānī
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v38: wanaṣabta fī ʿaraṣātihā khiyama ḍ-ḍiyā ʾinna l-ghawāmiḍa malʿabu ṣ-ṣabyāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v39: watuḥīlu kullu baladati bikhadhāfati nabbahta kam ʾayqaẓta bil-wasnāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v41: wayudīmu ʾahla n-naqli fīhi mazābirā yutlā wayusṭaru mā ʿarā l-malawāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v42: lil-hi fī t-taʾalīfi ḥawzu maṭālibi wabihi nfitāqu r-ratqi fī l-bībāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v43: wabihi nkishāfu fī jalābībi ṣ-ṣadā ʿan juljulāni ʾalīfihi biʾawāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v44: wabihi saʿādatu ʿābidi maʿbūdahu wabihi l-mtābu liʿābidi l-ʾawthāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v45: man shāhadat ʿaynāhu fī kalimātihi yughrā l-hudā ʾaw tasmaʿu l-ʾudhunāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v46: ʿafwu l-ʿafuwwi mumāziju ʾalfāẓuhu fatasāraʿū lil-ʿafwi wal-ghufrāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v47: man kāna murtahina ladā tabiʿātihi fal-fakku fī barakātihi biʿiyāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v48: ḥāshāhu ʾan yadhara mruʾu waʾaʿaddahu zāda l-maʿādi wathiqlaha l-mīzāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v49: ḥāshāhu ʾan yulfā l-fatā binadāmati min baʿdimā jalabat ʾilayhi l-ʾamānī
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v50: billāhi rabbī lā ʾuḥannithu yā fatā qasamī ʿalayyā bibāriʾi l-ʾakwāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v51: ʾinna l-hudāta humu r-rijālu ḥaqīqata ʾamʿin biṭarfika mahmaha ṭ-ṭughyāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v52: ʾakrim bihadhā sh-shaykhi wahwa khalīfatu min ʾakmali l-khulafāʾi lit-tijānī
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v54: ṭalaʿat lanā saʿda s-suʿūdi zamānanā nanjū bihā binawāʾibi d-dabarāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v55: lawla wujūduka fī z-zamāni ʾamātanā ʿaṭshu l-wuṣūli wakathratu d-dawrāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v56: nuljī ẓ-ẓuhūra wala narā min dawḥati wayurā binā ẓ-ẓamʾānu maʿ gharthāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v57: waʾakhadhta ḍabʿa d-dīni maṣraʿa ghurbahi warafaʿtahu bishahādati l-buldāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v58: watajaddadat fīhi l-maʿālimu muḥsina bibināʾihi huwa ghibṭatu l-bunyāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v59: waʾatayta tahdī s-sālikīna bisublihi wahumu htdā fī s-sayri ʿan hayamāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v60: watafīḍu minka fuyūḍu ʿirfāni jarat fī ʾaḥsani l-jarayāni was-sarayāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v61: waʾadarta fī baḥri l-ḥaqīqati fikrata watufīdunā ḥikamā kamā r-rayḥāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v62: watuḥīlu min naẓariyyī ʿilmi lil-fatā mithla ḍ-ḍarūrī ḥāwiyā bimaʿāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v63: waʾaṣabta fī falawātihi jawfa l-farā waḥawayta min furaṣi bikulli makāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v64: wajamaʿta fīhā shāridā waʾawābidā wasabaqta bil-fursāni ʿinda rihāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v65: ḥamda limāliki mulkihi waḥakīmihi biliqāʾinā l-ʾustādha ʿan jawlāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v66: waʿalā l-muqaffā sayyidi s-sādāti man ʾasrā bihi mawlahu wahwa yudānī
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v67: wabīʾālihi ʾaṣḥābihi hum ʾanjumu lil-muqtadīna sabīlahum lijanāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v68: ʾazkā ṣ-ṣalati maʿa s-salami tawāṣulā mā dārati l-ʾaflaku wal-malawāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v30: waʾanīsahu min kullimā ʾibbāni wayuṭāliʿu l-ʿabarāti qad ṣadarat ʿani l-
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v40: fallāhu yajʿalu fī l-kitābi riḍāʾahu waqabūlahu ʾan laysa lil-ʾinsāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v53: fajuzīta yā ʾamala l-wujūdi bijūdika l-kāfī yaʿʿumu ʿadāka maʿa ʾakhdāni
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v10: bal ʾinnahu taʾlīfu shaykhī māliki huwa ḥāmilu r-rāyāti fī t-tijānī
verses.hal-rawdatun-ghanna-u-c1-v36: waffarta ʾaqsāma l-funūni wawaffara r-raḥmānu ʿumraka fī l-warā miʿwānī
